title: Notice regarding Special Courts on 25.09.2026.
text:
KEY LINES:
Date: - 24/09/2026
It is hereby notified that on 25/09/2026;

FULL TEXT:
The High Court of Gujarat
Ahmedabad
Date: - 24/09/2026
N O T I C E
HCG-01/2026
It is hereby notified that on 25/09/2026;
1. At 02:30 PM Hon’ble the Chief Justice Mrs. Justice Sunita Agarwal
and Hon’ble Mr. Justice Pranav Trivedi would sit in Special Division
Bench and take up the notified matter/s.
2. After completion of matters at Sr. No.1 above, Hon’ble the Chief
Justice Mrs. Justice Sunita Agarwal would sit Single and take up
the matters as per Roster.
3. At 02:30 PM Hon’ble Mr. Justice A.S.Supehia and Hon’ble
Mr. Justice Vimal K. Vyas would sit in Special Division Bench and
take up the notified matter/s.
4. After completion of matters at Sr. No. 3 above,Hon’ble Mr. Justice
A.S.Supehia and Hon’ble Mr. Justice R. T. Vachchhani would sit in
Special Division Bench and take up the notified matter/s.
5. After completion of matters at Sr. No. 3 above, Hon’ble Mr. Justice
Vimal K. Vyas and Hon’ble Mr. Justice P. M. Raval would sit in
Special Division Bench and take up the notified matter/s.
6. After completion of matters at Sr. No. 1 above, Hon’ble Mr. Justice
Pranav Trivedi would sit Single and take up the matters as per
Roster.
7. After completion work of Regular Division Bench, Hon’ble Mr.
Justice J.L.Odedra would sit Single and take up the notified
matter/s.
By Order
Sd/-
Registrar Judicial
